P1.reason: A separates recognisable rules (switching, step sequence, winning, doors/picking); B lumps nearly every statement into one undifferentiated group, explaining nothing.

differences.reason: Gathers all legal moves plus opening; broad but coherent as 'what each player may do'. Helps somewhat.
Car persistence, final choice and goals: a clear 'who wins' rule. Helps.
Doors with hiding car and picking a door: the first-stage rule. Helps.
Step counter and termination: the three-stage turn order and ending. Helps.
Doors start closed and stay closed unless opened: a clean door-state rule. Helps.
Switch move and its effect on chosen door: exactly the switch-or-stay rule. Helps.
Almost the whole game in one group; no rule is distinguished. Hurts.
